standard.summary: Muon、Riemannion、Rose、Aurora、ADOPT、SOAP、MARS 等 frontier 优化器处于 release-hold 内部研究状态，不进入常规 optimizer_type 下拉。
standard.effect: 这些优化器仅保留 参考实现、治理 scorecard 或内部 smoke。常规训练请求会被 release-hold guard 拦截，直到 owner/release 审批解除。
standard.whenToUse: 当前不要在产品训练配置中选择这些优化器；只在内部 frontier provider smoke 或 owner review 证据链中验证。
standard.avoidWhen: 任何常规 WebUI、request adapter、训练入口或插件桥接路径都不应暴露或启用 held frontier optimizer。

standard_en.summary: The frontier optimizers Muon, Riemannion, Rose, Aurora, ADOPT, SOAP and MARS are in a release-hold internal research state and do not appear in the ordinary optimizer_type dropdown.
standard_en.effect: All that is kept for them is a reference implementation, a governance scorecard or an internal smoke. An ordinary training request is intercepted by the release-hold guard until the owner/release approval is lifted.
standard_en.whenToUse: Do not select these optimizers in a product training config for now; validate them only in the internal frontier provider smoke or in an owner-review evidence chain.
standard_en.avoidWhen: No ordinary WebUI, request adapter, training entry point or plugin bridge path should expose or enable a held frontier optimizer.

advanced.principle: frontier provenance 路线只允许基于论文/数学定义/本地 spec 的独立参考验证，不复制第三方实现，也不通过常规训练入口启用。
advanced.intervention: 无产品侧操作。若需要研究验证，走 backend/core/lulynx_trainer/frontier/frontier_optimizer_provider.py 的内部 smoke 路线。
advanced.expectedImpact: 尚未产品承诺；需要真实短训或工具 fixture、owner approval、release-hold clearance 后才能讨论暴露。
advanced.tradeoffs: 提前暴露会破坏 默认关闭、runtime/request 边界和 provenance 审计链。

advanced_en.principle: The frontier provenance route only allows independent reference verification based on papers/mathematical definitions/local specs — no copying third-party implementations and no enabling through regular training entry points.
advanced_en.intervention: No product-side operation. For research verification, use the internal smoke route at backend/core/lulynx_trainer/frontier/frontier_optimizer_provider.py.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No product commitment yet; exposure can only be discussed after real short runs or tool fixtures, owner approval, and release-hold clearance.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Premature exposure would break default-off, the runtime/request boundary, and the provenance audit chain.
